question: Ustad Allah Rakha and Ustad Zakir Hussain are both famous __________ players of India.
solution:
The correct answer is __**tabla**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Ustad Allah Rakha** and **Ustad Zakir Hussain** are renowned tabla players from India.
 
• The **tabla** is a popular Indian percussion instrument used in various genres of Indian music.
 
• Both musicians have significantly contributed to the global recognition and appreciation of the tabla.
 
• They have performed internationally and collaborated with various artists across different music genres.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Ustad Allah Rakha** was a prominent tabla player, often accompanying legendary sitar virtuoso Ravi Shankar.
 
• **Ustad Zakir Hussain**, son of Ustad Allah Rakha, is a Grammy-winning tabla maestro known for his versatility and collaborations with international artists.
 
• The tabla consists of a pair of drums, each producing distinct sounds, and is fundamental to Hindustani classical music.
 
• Learning and mastering the tabla requires rigorous training and practice under the guidance of an experienced guru.
